<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Tunnel Wall](/Feats.aspx?ID=4174) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 110

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172); [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839)

**Requirements**
You are in Tenacious Stance.

</column>

---

Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone. You [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98) and become anchored for 1 round. While anchored, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DC to [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=29) your space.
name: Tunnel Wall
